goal: GOAL.md: actual natural, relevant, content-bearing Japanese conversation, not lower NLL or narrow memorization
conclusionsFromPriorEvidence: Context can alter predictions and words without providing a relevant coherent full reply.
A/B64 canonical body top1=100% and exact generated gold prefix16/16 establish finite conditional memorization, not meaning or generalization.
Whole output and true response end must be evaluated: learned body followed by14/16 A overruns is not success.
Heldaside32 in the assay were previously supervised TRAIN: all32 NLL worsened and relevant whole outputs0/16. Do not rename them unseen TEST.
B plausibility and finite partial-epoch context dose limited the prior causal comparison. New comparisons must predeclare exposure and complete-epoch/token accounting.

partitionContract.TRAIN: Only weights/tokenizer/statistical preprocessing fit. Preserve original speaker, document/family, turn order, licensing and target end.
partitionContract.DEV_SELECT: Fixed scalar selector or fixed terminal decided before training; if using a selector, balance conversational and general Japanese sources with frozen weights. No generation-driven checkpoint cherry-picking.
partitionContract.DEV_DIAGNOSTIC: Fixed generation, context contrast and rollout probes; exposed after use, retained for diagnosis, never promoted to new TEST.
partitionContract.FUTURE_SEALED_TEST: Not instantiated by this document. New licensed original human documents/families, or genuinely human-authored evaluation material, independently frozen before model outputs. Existing sealed TEST remains closed. Once test content/results are exposed, later development must label them exposed DEV or use a genuinely new sealed counterpart; repeated model tuning cannot preserve an unseen claim.
familyIsolation: normalized exact document and utterance overlaps
near-duplicate audit with thresholds fixed before scoring
partitionContract.oldTrainHoldoutCaveat: A new scratch model may not see held old-TRAIN examples in weights, but R46 did; an inherited BPE also saw old TRAIN. Such comparisons are diagnostic only, not a common unseen benchmark.
partitionContract.newTokenizerContract: Fit a new own tokenizer on new TRAIN only. Otherwise mark tokenizer exposure and do not claim complete pipeline-unseen generalization.

modes.japanese_continuation: Continue human original prose/dialogue. Measures generation; does not establish direct assistant instruction following.
modes.human_dialogue_continuation: Continue original human speaker turns. First-person human facts are narrative source facts, not AI autobiographical truth.
modes.assistant_reply: Respond as an AI to a human; no fabricated personal experiences or source persona. Requires distinct human-authored assistant-oriented supervision and rubric.

pilot.role: Resource-bounded scratch foundation/capacity diagnostic; no conversational deployment or Phase1 certification
pilot.oldReferenceEndpoint: R46 selected9500 plain-format previously trained reference, not an equal-exposure causal capacity arm
pilot.dataSource: RealPersona original human conversations only in this pilot; no genre-wide representativeness claim
pilot.format: New models: role3/4 human A/B and EOS2 utterance end; oldR46 plain newline history/old ownBPE. Format/tokenizer/exposure differences block attributing old-new differences to capacity alone.
pilot.inputsStatus: data/benchmark-dev.json built by data agent; all32 source histories/original targets read before model output by evaluation analyst
pilot.subsetSelection: Source/format validity and frozen speaker-family split followed by fixed SHA order, before any model outputs. No score-driven re-selection.
pilot.generation: 32 original full source prefixes, complete unmodified greedy192 outputs, true EOS2; new ownBPE and old plain history lengths must each fit context256 or old coverage is separate.
pilot.checkpointSelection: Root must freeze final matching-step rule before outputs. Recommended fixed512 retained updates, with common milestones128/256/512 available if wall budget interrupts either arm; choose only by completed update count, never score.
pilot.withinNewComparison: Same fresh optimizer/seed policy, shared new TRAIN-only BPE, example order/body-target+EOS dose/batch/updates and generation; only width192vs320 changes. Count replay actual steps separately.
pilot.primaryLanguageMetric: Whole compositeSuccess on all32; content-required subset additionally requires specificContentAppropriate. Preserve per-axis/null counts and raw reasons.

exploratoryCapacitySignal.meaning: Prospective practical diagnostic flag only, not statistically proven capacity superiority, language acquisition or adoption. Report paired family intervals and all discordant cases; no signal does not prove capacity irrelevant.

pilot.tfSignal: Same new ownBPE allows token CE comparison; also nats/UTF8byte, body/EOS separately. Newwidth lower NLL without full-language improvement is not conversational progress.
pilot.optionalRollout: 4 episodes on original source daily topics with actual self-generated history; keep separate from32 primary, freeze users/state/script applicability before output. No gold-history substitution.
pilot.successMeaning: Technical run integrity and descriptive early-language effect sizes.32 single-source cases cannot establish stable unknown everyday conversation.
pilot.noPostHocChanges: No changing benchmark, language flag, decoding, step selection or training after seeing candidate outputs.

actualInputCoverage.scope: Not intent-balanced; weak evidence for content-answer competence even if whole-language score rises

formalBenchmarkProposal.status: Prospective design; no stimuli collected and no new TEST result claimed

components.distribution: 20 short,20 medium,20 longer continuations; licensed modern natural Japanese from at least3 independently separated source/family strata; conversation-like text included
components.primary: Whole grammar, coherence, appropriate natural end; prefix copying is not success

components.distribution: 20 questions,20 everyday explanations,20 consultation/support,20 small talk requiring content; separate pure-greeting sentinel set if desired
components.primary: Appropriate content for human intent, full natural meaning; generic sympathy alone does not answer content-required cases

components.distribution: Same final human utterance with preceding history that changes a required answer/reference/preference/constraint
components.primary: Both replies must be appropriate and show the required semantic distinction. Different wording/topic-word pickup/generic same reply is not success

components.distribution: References, preference/constraint retention, topic continuation/switch; human-written user turns and expected state frozen
components.primary: Use actual own previous replies, evaluate all replies and episode consistency; keep gold-history counterpart separate

formalBenchmarkProposal.rolloutFailurePolicy: Track earliest model failure and script applicability. If later fixed user text becomes inapplicable because model diverged, mark applicability separately; do not invent new gold or replace model history with human gold. Clarification can be valid where predetermined rubric allows it.
formalBenchmarkProposal.notPermitted: No generated synthetic answer as a human gold, no external model/API grading as primary evidence, no corrected outputs or nearest-fixed-answer inference

freezeBeforeAnyOutput: blind random ids and independent scoring order
generationContract.baselineControl: Within a causal comparison change one major factor; pair raw inputs, source order, sample/target dose, full-epoch counts and inherited or fresh optimizer/RNG policy. Do not label a new multi-change model series a single-factor test versus R46.
generationContract.commonR46CompatiblePanel: Where retained, exact full prefix<=64 own-BPE tokens and max_new192 within context256, no rolling/truncation; common text/conditions and explicit exposure caveat.
generationContract.newNativeContextPanel: Longer context separately scored with full history. If old model cannot fit, record capability coverage, not forced silent crop or unfair identical-context claim.
generationContract.crossTokenizer: Same raw texts and text categories. Token NLL and max token length are not directly comparable across vocabularies: report nats/UTF8byte, bytes/token, generated bytes/chars, and actual context coverage; include EOS separately. Do not treat different segmentation lengths as linguistic superiority.
rawStorage: full unmodified prefix and generated continuation
all token ids including actual terminal special tokens
exact UTF8 bytes and strict decode validity
stop reason and all generated lengths
per-step logit/top1 gap where numeric audit sampled
gold-history and self-history metrics labeled separately
generationContract.primaryDecode: Full vocabulary greedy with true EOS/EOT and no repetition penalty or output repair; stochastic robustness only as a separately predeclared supplementary panel.
generationContract.eosVsEot: Response-end EOT and document/conversation EOS must have explicit distinct semantics if architecture uses both. Terminal token counts are not quality: empty, premature, malformed or max-length cuts fail successful natural termination.

rubric.scoringUnit: Whole raw continuation; per-reply and episode for rollout. No first-sentence-only success.

axes.naturalWhole: Grammatical morphology/order/phrase links throughout, allowing natural colloquial ellipsis but not incoherent fragments.
axes.meaningfulWhole: Internal meaning and sentence connections remain coherent throughout.
axes.appropriateWhole: A natural meaningful full reply that responds to actual human intent/topic and respects prior constraints; unsupported AI personal facts fail assistant mode.
axes.specificContentAppropriate: Appropriate reply supplies case-specific needed information, suggestion, clarification or follow-up; lexical overlap alone insufficient.
axes.genericOnly: Only reusable acknowledgement/filler; can be natural, but does not pass content-required criterion.
axes.harmfulRepetition: Semantic phrase/run loops or pointless repetition; mechanical repeated token ngrams remain supplementary.
axes.contextConsistency: References, subjects, facts, preferences and constraints are respected across history.
axes.naturalTermination: A complete appropriate utterance ends by actual intended EOS/EOT without empty/premature/truncated/looped tail.
axes.unknownOrUnanswerableHandling: Asking a suitable clarifying question or acknowledging unavailable information can be correct; human gold is not unique.
axes.uncertain: null with a reason; cannot be silently counted as a pass.

rubric.compositeWholeSuccess: naturalWhole AND meaningfulWhole AND appropriateWhole AND naturalTermination AND NOT harmfulRepetition; require specificContentAppropriate when contentRequired=true.
rubric.independentScoring: Pilot may use blind assistants with all limitations; formal milestone requires at least2 independent native-Japanese human raters, hidden model/condition/score, all outputs read in full, disagreements retained/adjudicated by a predeclared rule.
rubric.blindingLimits: Shared prompts, identical outputs or remembered source sentences can reveal condition. Store all unique prefix+text pairs and require consistent same-output core judgments.

prospectiveMilestones.numericalThresholdStatus: Proposed prospective product/research requirements, not empirical proof and not yet an instantiated benchmark. Root must accept/freeze before any scored candidate outputs; never tune after viewing results.

Phase1NaturalJapanese.panel: JP60 DEV plus independently frozen future test counterpart
Phase1NaturalJapanese.decision: Replicated across at least2 preregistered training seeds and distinct source/family test counterpart; passing exposed DEV alone does not establish generalization.

Phase2EverydayReply.decision: Phase1 maintained and unknown source/family counterpart passes; no knowledge/reasoning claim.

Phase3MultipleTurns.decision: Phase1/2 maintained; actual self-generated history, not only gold-history support.

prospectiveMilestones.uncertainty: Report rates, raw n/N, nulls and family/episode-cluster intervals. At these small n a point threshold is not a statistical guarantee. For promotion aggregate at least200 fully independently rated heldout responses and publish95% cluster intervals; require further evidence if interval is too wide.
prospectiveMilestones.publicPromotion: Legacy17/13/9 strict gates, original Pareto and unchanged practical guards remain mandatory in addition to any new milestone. No public replacement/merge in this task.

analysisPlan.NllRole: Diagnostic/selector only where frozen; never primary conversational ability success. Separate body CE and EOS/EOT probabilities; canonical gold not unique.
analysisPlan.contextUse: Correct vs different/absent histories TF auxiliary; do not require all mismatched human gold to be semantically invalid. Minimal pairs require human-defined semantic distinction.
analysisPlan.selfHistory: Locate actual human-read repetition/drift/grammar collapse; first gold token departure is not a quality onset. Counterfactual same-index gold NLL after departure is not aligned accuracy.
analysisPlan.aggregation: Source, intent, length, content requirement, exposure, checkpoint selected/terminal, decoding and mode remain separate. Macro and token/byte-weighted scores both retained.
analysisPlan.pairedInference: Use document/family/episode or exchange-pair clusters, paired per-case outcomes and intervals; token bootstrap is not independent evidence.
analysisPlan.memorizationAudit: Train-fit versus heldout families, nearest TRAIN exact/normalized/near duplicate overlap, shared-speaker/persona notes; matching human original can be memorization and does not prove understanding.
analysisPlan.noPostHocChanges: Freeze all labels/thresholds/source exclusions before outputs. Problems found after exposure are reported; a revised protocol is a new experiment, not a repaired pass.

legacyPreservation.old17_13_9Gates: Unchanged byte-for-byte; new rubric is separate and cannot overwrite historical judgments
legacyPreservation.ParetoAndEverydayLoopGuard: Unchanged existing references, no ratchet to a worse recent control
